question: Which customers each contributed 10% or more of Fabrinet's revenues in fiscal 2026 (year ended June 26, 2026), and what percentage of revenue did each represent?
grading: Key points: four customers each >=10% of FY2026 revenue: Cisco Systems 19.9%, NVIDIA 16.3%, Nokia 10.7%, Amazon.com 10.5% (together 57.4%). Accept +/-0.1pp. Fail if fewer than all four are named or if FY2025 shares (NVIDIA 27.6%, Cisco 18.2%) are given for FY2026.
answer: In fiscal 2026 (ended June 26, 2026) four customers each contributed 10% or more of Fabrinet's revenues: Cisco Systems 19.9%, NVIDIA 16.3%, Nokia 10.7% and Amazon.com 10.5%, together 57.4% of revenue. In fiscal 2025 only NVIDIA (27.6%) and Cisco (18.2%) exceeded 10% [H07-E1].

output.answer:
**Fabrinet's fiscal 2026 (year ended June 26, 2026) 10-K discloses four customers that each contributed 10% or more of revenues:**

| Customer | % of FY2026 Revenues |
|---|---|
| Cisco Systems, Inc. | 19.9% |
| NVIDIA Corporation | 16.3% |
| Nokia Corporation | 10.7% |
| Amazon.com, Inc. | 10.5% |

For comparison, in fiscal 2025 Fabrinet had only two such customers: NVIDIA (27.6%) and Cisco (18.2%). The company noted that FY2026 revenue was $4.64 billion, up ~36% year over year, and that four (rather than two) 10%+ customers reflects some diversification of its customer base.

Note: Fabrinet's Q4 FY2026 earnings call commentary rounded these same figures as Cisco ~20%, NVIDIA ~16%, Nokia ~11%, and Amazon ~11%, while the 10-K text states the precise 19.9%, 16.3%, 10.7% and 10.5%. Nokia's emergence as a 10%+ customer was attributed to the combination of legacy Infinera business plus new Nokia business.

Sources:
- [Fabrinet FY2026 Form 10-K (SEC, filed Aug. 18, 2026)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1408710/000140871026000028/fn-20260626.htm)
- [Fabrinet Q4/FY2026 results press release](https://investor.fabrinet.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fabrinet-announces-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2026-financial)
- [Q4 FY2026 earnings call highlights (customer concentration summary)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/fabrinet-fn-q4-2026-earnings-050212828.html)
